_meta.description: Per-100g nutrition values for grains/products used across Naturals millet pouches, brown sugar, and (pending) laddu recipe ingredients.
_meta.primary_source: ICMR-NIN Indian Food Composition Tables (IFCT) 2017, via eatrightindia.gov.in (FSSAI-affiliated) 'Millets - Nutritious Cereal of India'
_meta.secondary_source: USDA FoodData Central (used where ICMR-NIN had no direct entry, e.g. Barley); secondary Indian nutrition compilations for Coconut/Palm Jaggery Powder (no direct ICMR-NIN IFCT line item found for these)
_meta.units: energy_kcal = kcal/100g; protein_g, fat_g, carbohydrate_g, fiber_g = grams/100g
caveats: Values are per raw/whole grain. The same figure is applied across Flakes/Rava/Flour/Rice/Parboiled formats of the same grain -- minor real differences from processing (e.g. flaking, milling) are not separately accounted for.
Red Sorghum and White Sorghum both use the single published Sorghum (Jowar) reference value -- no separate red/white breakdown was found.

Laddu products are NOT included here -- they are prepared/composite foods (grain + jaggery + ghee + nuts) and calorie calculation depends on the actual recipe ratio, which is still unconfirmed (see project_naturals_laddu_boxes memory: ingredient lists are draft/standard-recipe assumptions). Deferred until recipe ratios are confirmed.

Brown Sugar here uses jaggery/gur-style reference values (unrefined, molasses-retaining), matching the product's own description ('rich molasses extraction') rather than fully-refined white/brown sugar values.

sorghum.name: Sorghum (Jowar) -- covers both Red Sorghum and White Sorghum SKUs

barley.name: Barley (pearled)
barley.note: No direct ICMR-NIN millet-table entry found; used USDA FoodData Central value for pearled barley, raw.

coconut_jaggery.name: Coconut Jaggery Powder
coconut_jaggery.note: Secondary-source Indian nutrition compilations (not a direct ICMR-NIN IFCT line item) -- retains more protein/fiber than sugarcane-derived Brown Sugar, consistent with palm-family jaggery generally.

palm_jaggery.name: Palm Jaggery Powder
palm_jaggery.note: Secondary-source Indian nutrition compilations (not a direct ICMR-NIN IFCT line item). Toddy/palmyra palm jaggery specifically -- values converge closely with coconut jaggery in available sources, both being palm-derived (distinct from sugarcane-derived Brown Sugar's lower protein/fiber profile).
